corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Comprehensive Proposal: Real-Time Warehouse Inventory Dashboard

**Submitted by:** BrightPath Software Solutions
**Client:** NordFrame Logistics GmbH

## 1. Executive Summary
BrightPath Software Solutions is pleased to submit this comprehensive proposal for the NordFrame Logistics Warehouse Inventory Dashboard. We propose a robust, real-time web dashboard that unifies inventory tracking across your 6 regional warehouses in Germany and Austria. Our solution directly integrates with your existing PostgreSQL database, enforces strict role-based access control, and delivers automated low-stock alerts—all delivered within a 6-month timeline and a fixed budget of €95,000.

## 2. Technical Solution & Architecture
We will build a high-performance, responsive web-based dashboard utilizing modern frontend frameworks (React) backed by a secure Node.js API service. Real-time updates will be handled via WebSockets to ensure instant inventory visibility across all regional locations.

## 3. PostgreSQL Database Integration
Our solution connects directly to your existing PostgreSQL inventory database via secure connection pooling. No database migration, schema restructuring, or data duplication is required, preserving your current infrastructure integrity and eliminating downtime risks.

## 4. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
The platform incorporates granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):
- **Warehouse Managers:** Restricted to viewing and managing inventory exclusively for their assigned local facility.
- **HQ Staff / Executives:** Granted global visibility and reporting capabilities across all 6 German and Austrian warehouses.

## 5. Automated Low-Stock Alerts
The system features automated low-stock monitoring. Warehouse managers can configure custom inventory thresholds per SKU. When stock falls below the threshold, automated email and in-app notifications are instantly dispatched to relevant personnel.

## 6. Timeline and Onboarding Plan
The project will be executed in two disciplined phases:
- **Phase 1 (Months 1–3):** Requirements finalization, core dashboard development, and a working pilot deployed at one designated warehouse.
- **Phase 2 (Months 4–6):** Refinement based on pilot feedback, user training, and full rollout across the remaining 5 sites, culminating in total deployment within 6 months with minimal operational disruption.

## 7. Support, Maintenance, and SLAs
First-year support and maintenance are fully included in the project cost. Our SLA guarantees:
- **Critical Incidents:** Response within 4 hours, 24/7 triage.
- **Standard Support:** Monday–Friday, 08:00–18:00 CET, with a 4-hour response time for high-priority tickets.
- **Maintenance:** Regular security patches and monthly health checks.

## 8. Assumptions and Risks
- **Assumptions:** Stable network connectivity between regional warehouses and the centralized PostgreSQL instance; availability of designated NordFrame stakeholders for weekly sprint reviews.
- **Risks & Mitigation:** Potential network latency across remote sites will be mitigated through intelligent local caching and optimized database indexing.

## 9. Pricing and Commercials
- **Total Fixed Price:** €95,000 (Inclusive of development, pilot, full rollout, training, and Year 1 support).
- **Payment Schedule:** Milestone-based (30% upon contract signing, 30% upon successful pilot go-live, 40% upon full 6-site rollout).

## 10. Conclusion
BrightPath Software Solutions combines deep logistics domain expertise with modern technical execution. We look forward to partnering with NordFrame Logistics to successfully deliver this critical inventory dashboard.
